CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFTHROW

CFTHROW raises an exception of your own. Processing jumps to the nearest CFCATCH that handles its TYPE; if there is none, the page stops with the standard error message. Use it to report problems that KoldFusion itself would not notice, such as an order for minus three modems.

Category

Exception handling

Syntax

<CFTHROW TYPE="exception_type"
    MESSAGE="message"
    DETAIL="detail_description"
    ERRORCODE="error_code"
    EXTENDEDINFO="additional_information">

Attributes

TYPE
Optional, default "Application". The type of the error. Use your own name, preferably dotted like MyApp.Order.BadQuantity, so that CFCATCH TYPE="MyApp.Order" or TYPE="MyApp" can catch whole families of errors. The only built-in type you may throw is Application.
MESSAGE
Optional. The error message, available as CFCATCH.Message.
DETAIL
Optional. A longer description, available as CFCATCH.Detail.
ERRORCODE
Optional. A code of your choosing, available as CFCATCH.ErrorCode.
EXTENDEDINFO
Optional. Any additional information, available as CFCATCH.ExtendedInfo.

Usage

Without a MESSAGE, the message reads "Unhandled exception of type ..." with the type filled in. Throwing an error from deep inside a custom tag is a clean way to let the calling page decide what to do about it.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Validate some orders; bad ones are thrown and caught by family --->
<CFSET Orders = "Modem:3,Mouse pad:-2,Zip drive:0,Keyboard:abc,Monitor:1">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Product</TH><TH>Qty</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="Order" LIST="#Orders#">
  <CFSET Product = ListFirst(Order, ":")>
  <CFSET Qty = ListLast(Order, ":")>
  <CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#Product#</TD><TD>#Qty#</TD></CFOUTPUT>
  <CFTRY>
    <CFIF NOT IsNumeric(Qty)>
      <CFTHROW TYPE="Snippets.Order.NotANumber" MESSAGE="Quantity is not a number"
               ERRORCODE="ORD-1" DETAIL="Use digits, please.">
    <CFELSEIF Qty LT 1>
      <CFTHROW TYPE="Snippets.Order.TooFew" MESSAGE="Quantity must be at least 1"
               ERRORCODE="ORD-2" EXTENDEDINFO="Qty=#Qty#">
    </CFIF>
    <TD BGCOLOR="#CCFFCC">Accepted</TD>
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Snippets.Order">
    <CFOUTPUT><TD BGCOLOR="##FFE0E0">#CFCATCH.ErrorCode#: #CFCATCH.Message#
    <FONT SIZE="1">(#CFCATCH.Type#)</FONT></TD></CFOUTPUT>
  </CFCATCH>
  </CFTRY>
  </TR>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
